docs.title: starcheck docs
docs.text:
The README is the pitch. This folder is the reference.

  • SCORECARD.md — every check, its weight, and the exact evidence it reads
  • LAUNCH.md — how this repo itself was launched (the playbook, unedited)

docs.title: The one idea
docs.text:
Star count is not a code-quality metric. It is:

stars  ≈  exposure  ×  first-screen conversion  ×  reuse frequency

starcheck can only measure the middle term honestly, and it is the one you control completely. The other two are distribution work, which is why the tool refuses to give you a "viral" score and stops at 100.

docs.title: Why weights, not a checklist
docs.text: A checklist tells you 20 things are wrong and you fix none of them. Weights force an order. A fail on a weight-5 check (README hook, install command, GIF) costs more than four weight-1 checks, because that is how a stranger's attention actually works: they leave in the first screen.

docs.title: Why some checks are skip
docs.text:
Local mode cannot know your repo description, topics, or homepage — those live on GitHub, not on disk. skip removes the item from the denominator instead of pretending it failed, so a local score stays comparable with a remote one.

Run starcheck owner/repo (or starcheck . --remote owner/repo) to fill them in.

docs.title: Limits
docs.text:
• It cannot see stars, traffic, or conversion. It scores readiness, not results.
  • It cannot judge whether your project is interesting. A 100 here with a boring idea is still a boring idea.
  • It has no opinion about your architecture, and it never will.

docs.title: Launch notes
docs.text:
This is the distribution half of starcheck — the part that has nothing to do with code. It is written as a runbook, not a blog post, because the same file gets reused for the next project.

The whole thesis in one line:

stars ≈ exposure × first-screen conversion × reuse frequency starcheck measures the middle term. This document is about the first one.

docs.title: 0. Before anything: the 10-item go-live checklist
docs.text:
Nothing below matters until these are true. All of them are gh one-liners.

gh repo create chxhwc/starcheck --public --source=. --remote=origin --push

# description = the pitch, 160 chars max, no buzzwords
gh repo edit --description "Audit any repo for star-readiness: 28 checks, one score, copy-paste fixes."

# topics = the search surface. 10+, lowercase, hyphenated
gh repo edit \
  --add-topic cli --add-topic developer-tools --add-topic github \
  --add-topic readme --add-topic opensource --add-topic python \
  --add-topic static-analysis --add-topic productivity --add-topic linter \
  --add-topic growth

gh repo edit --homepage "https://chxhwc.github.io/starcheck/"
gh repo edit --enable-discussions
# 事项 为什么是硬前置 1 description 写好 搜索结果里只有这一行 2 topics ≥ 10 GitHub 站内搜索的主要入口 3 上传 social preview（assets/social.png，1280×640） 分享出去的卡片默认是灰的 4 打 tag：git tag v0.4.0 && git push --tags watcher 的第一次唤醒 5 Pages 打开（mkdocs.yml 已就绪） 多一个能被搜到的入口 6 发 PyPI（release.yml 已就绪，配 PYPI_API_TOKEN） uvx starcheck 才算真的存在 7 README 首屏有 GIF + 一条安装命令 决定了 90% 的转化 8 Discussions 打开 给"用不了"的人一个不用开 issue 的出口 9 自己的仓库先打 95+ 第一个被 starcheck 审计的仓库必须是自己 10 准备好一条 20 字以内的转述 别人帮你传播时只需要这一句

docs.title: 1. 叙事：为什么别人愿意转
docs.text:
工具类仓库传播的燃料从来不是功能，是一句话能复述的立场。

版本 文案 用途 钩子（英） Your repo is good. That is why nobody stars it. README 首屏、HN 标题 钩子（中） 你的项目很好。所以才没人 star。 即刻、V2EX、朋友圈 转述句 A linter for the things that actually decide whether a repo gets stars. 别人帮你介绍时 反差数据 我审计了 100 个 0-star 的仓库，79 个没有 description，64 个没有演示图。 长文开头（数据要自己跑一遍）

规则：先给立场，再给工具。没人转发"一个 CLI"，大家转发"一句他一直想说但没说出口的话"。

docs.title: 2. 首发日时间表（北京时间）
docs.text:
只在 周二或周三 发。UTC 13:00–15:00 ≈ 北京 21:00–23:00 = 美东上午 9 点。

时间 动作 目的 T-3 天 只在 r/coolgithubprojects 这类小池子发一次 拿真实反馈改 README，不消耗主渠道 T-0 21:00 Hacker News Show HN，单点打 天花板由它决定 T-0 21:10 自己发第一条评论：讲实现里最脏的那个坑 HN 排名很吃评论活跃度 T-0 23:30 看 2 小时数据：<10 分就放弃 HN，转 Reddit 不恋战 T+1 09:00 Reddit 对应 sub（一天最多两个） 美国时间的第二波 T+1 20:00 中文渠道：V2EX + 即刻 + 掘金 国内晚上是高峰 T+2 写一条"首发复盘"（数据全公开） 复盘文本身就是二次传播物 T+3 awesome-list PR × 8 长期免费流量，不占当天

一次只开一个渠道。 同时全发＝无法归因，第二篇就没有可复用的经验。

docs.title: Hacker News — Show HN
docs.text:
Show HN: starcheck – audit a repo for star-readiness (28 checks, one score)

I kept giving the same advice to people with good repos and no stars: your README
opens with a table of contents, your install command is 240 lines down, there is no
GIF, your description is empty. All true, all useless, because there was never a
way to know when you were done.

So I made it falsifiable. 28 checks over four weighted dimensions (discovery,
conversion, credibility, distribution), one 0-100 score, and a paste-ready command
for every failure.

Design constraints, because they matter more than the feature list:
- stdlib only. `uvx starcheck` in 3 seconds, no venv, no install.
- every check must be decidable from the repo alone. Anything requiring taste is
  in the docs, not in the code.
- `skip` is not `fail`: offline mode cannot see your description or topics, so
  those drop out of the denominator instead of pretending to fail.
- it never executes code from the audited repo. It reads files as text.
- the box drawing degrades to ASCII on a GBK console instead of crashing.

It scores readiness, not results — it has no idea whether your idea is interesting.

    uvx starcheck owner/repo

https://github.com/chxhwc/starcheck

第一条评论（自己发，10 分钟内）：

Author here. The part I got wrong first: I assumed weight should track "how much
this annoys me". It should track how much it costs conversion.

A missing LICENSE (weight 3) does not lose you a visitor. A README with no GIF and
no install command in the first screen (weight 5 each) loses you most of them. The
scoring model got much more useful once I made weights a budget — no single check
may move the score by more than ~7 points.

Happy to argue about any of the 28. That is what docs/SCORECARD.md is for.

docs.title: Reddit — r/commandline, r/opensource, r/coolgithubprojects
docs.text:
标题（不带感叹号，sub 规则不同）：

starcheck: a linter for the things that actually decide whether a repo gets stars

正文：首图 assets/social.png + HN 正文前两段 + 一条 curl/uvx 命令。不要在正文里说 "please star"，七个 sub 里有五个会因此删帖。

docs.title: X / Twitter — 一条主推 + 三条回复
docs.text:
Your repo is good. That is why nobody stars it.

I built a linter for the 28 things that actually decide it — description, topics,
first-screen install, GIF, maintenance signals.

28 checks. One score. Zero dependencies.

uvx starcheck

[GIF]

回复 1：一张 62/100 的真实审计截图（红黄绿一眼看懂） 回复 2：--fix 的输出（哦，它还给命令） 回复 3：--badge + "put the score in your README, it is also a share button"

docs.title: V2EX（分享创造）
docs.text:
标题：starcheck：给仓库做一次「star 就绪度」体检，28 项，一个分数

正文结构：痛点两句 → 一张 GIF → 一条命令 → 四个维度的表 → 「它不判断你的点子有没有意思」。 结尾放 GitHub 链接，不要放 star 请求。

docs.title: 掘金 / 少数派
docs.text: 不要发工具介绍，发方法文：《我审计了 100 个 0 star 的仓库，发现了 5 个共同点》， 工具只在文末出现一次。方法文的阅读量通常是工具文的 5 倍。

docs.title: 4. awesome-list 提交清单
docs.text:
一个 PR 加一行，长期免费流量。按契合度排：

仓库 建议归入 matiassingers/awesome-readme Tools / Linters agarrharr/awesome-cli-apps Development vinta/awesome-python Tools → Command-line Application Development sdras/awesome-actions Tooling Kikobeats/awesome-github Tools dkhamsing/open-source-ios-apps 不适用，跳过 mikethebeast/awesome-devtools（或同类 devtools 列表） CLI 521xueweihan/HelloGitHub 提 issue 自荐，每月一期 ruanyf/weekly 提 issue，注明「自荐」

行格式（照抄列表里相邻条目，别自己发明格式）：

- [starcheck](https://github.com/chxhwc/starcheck) - Audit a repo for star-readiness: 28 checks, one score, paste-ready fixes.

PR 描述模板：

Adds starcheck, a zero-dependency CLI that scores a repo against 28
star-readiness checks. Relevant here because it is a README/distribution
linter, which is what this list is about.

docs.title: 5. 周刊投稿
docs.text:
目标 入口 备注 HelloGitHub GitHub issue 自荐 中文，月度，命中率高 阮一峰周刊 ruanyf/weekly issue 中文，周五发，注明自荐 Console Dev console.dev/submit 专门收 CLI 工具，转化极好 Python Weekly pythonweekly.com 提交表单 英文 PyCoders Weekly pycoders.com 提交 英文 TLDR / Changelog Weekly 官网表单 需要一点新闻性（如 v1.0）

邮件正文（≤120 词，别写长）：

Subject: starcheck — a linter for repo star-readiness (zero deps)

Hi — one-line pitch: starcheck audits a repo against the 28 signals that decide
whether strangers star it (description, topics, first-screen install, GIF,
maintenance signals), returns one score, and prints the exact commands to fix
the top 3.

Why it fits your readers: it is a two-minute `uvx` call with no dependencies,
and the output is a screenshot people paste into their own README.

  uvx starcheck owner/repo            # https://github.com/chxhwc/starcheck

docs.title: 6. 第一周的承接（比首发更重要）
docs.text:
首发只决定前 200 个 star，承接决定后面 2000 个。

  • 12 小时内回完所有 issue，哪怕只是 "reproduced, fix tonight"。
  • 合并 3 个外部 PR，并在 CHANGELOG 里点名。每个贡献者都是一个传播节点。
  • 把最常见的抱怨变成 v0.5 的第一个 feature，然后在 issue 里 @ 那个人。
  • 每天发一条审计别人的实录（征得同意的公开仓库），配一句结论。这是可复用的内容引擎： starcheck psf/requests → 一张图 → "一个 6 万 star 的仓库也才 84 分，因为 X"。
  • 发一次 v0.5 release：watcher 通知是唯一能主动触达老用户的通道。

docs.title: 7. 指标与止损
docs.text:
时间 看什么 合格线 不合格怎么办 T+2h HN 分数 ≥ 10 放弃 HN，转 Reddit，别重发 T+24h star 增量 ≥ 50 说明首屏没说服人 → 改 GIF 和标题，不重发 T+72h star/访客比 ≥ 5% 说明来的人不对 → 换渠道，不换文案 T+7d fork 数 ≥ 3 说明没人想改 → 说明工具太窄，考虑加维度 T+30d 自然流量占比 ≥ 30% 说明没沉淀 → 补齐 awesome-list 和周刊

止损规则：同一个渠道，同一份文案，只发一次。 重发换的是标题和首图，不是时间。

docs.title: 8. 反模式
docs.text:
• 买 star / 互 star 群：GitHub 有异常增长检测，账号降权、Trending 直接踢； star/fork 比例失真后，懂行的人扫一眼仓库就知道，在招聘和融资场景是负资产。
  • "求 star"：七个 sub 里有五个会因此删帖，HN 会直接沉。
  • 抽奖换 star：来的人永远不会用你的工具，转化率数据从此不可信。
  • 一次发十个渠道：无法归因，第二次就没有可复用的经验。
  • 把首发当终点：首发之后的两周，才是 star 曲线真正分叉的地方。

docs.title: 9. 这份 runbook 的复用方式
docs.text:
下次做新项目，只需要改三处：

  1. 第 1 节的四句话（钩子、转述句、反差数据）
  2. 第 3 节的标题和正文
  3. 第 4 节的 awesome-list 清单

其余（时间表、承接 SOP、指标、反模式）与项目无关，直接照抄。

docs.title: Scorecard
docs.text:
Every check, its weight, and exactly what evidence it reads. Total weight: 72. Score = 100 × Σ(weight × factor) / Σ(weight), where pass = 1.0, warn = 0.5, fail = 0, and skip is removed from the denominator.

Weights are a budget, not a vote. If a single check can move the score by more than ~7 points, it is probably measuring two things at once.

docs.title: 已知偏差
docs.text:
• awesome 是启发式。 它只检查 README 里有没有 awesome-list 链接，判断不了 你是否真的被收录了。权重 1，不打算修。
  • desc / topics / homepage / docs-site 依赖网络。 本地模式全部 skip， 所以本地分和远程分不能直接比。
  • hook 只看首 10 行。 一个很好的 README 也可能因为一行烂标题拿不到分——这正是 想抓的东西。
  • 它不测「有没有人 star」。 见 docs/index.md。
